source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: A set is a collection of objects called its elements; sets are named with capital letters and listed in braces.
stages.headlineEnglish: A set is a collection of objects called its elements; sets are named with capital letters and listed in braces.

stages.headline: A set with no elements is empty, ∅. If every element of B is in A, B is a subset of A: B ⊂ A.
stages.headlineEnglish: A set with no elements is empty, ∅. If every element of B is in A, B is a subset of A: B ⊂ A.

stages.headline: The union A ∪ B has elements in at least one of the sets; the intersection A ∩ B has elements in both.
stages.headlineEnglish: The union A ∪ B has elements in at least one of the sets; the intersection A ∩ B has elements in both.

stages.headline: A = {a; b; c}. Which statement is correct?
stages.headlineEnglish: A = {a; b; c}. Which statement is correct?

stages.headline: Write the set of all primes less than 10.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write the set of all primes less than 10.
stages.problemText: Write the set of all primes less than 10.

stages.headline: A = {1; 2; 3; 4; 5}, B = {4; 5; 6; 7}. Find A ∪ B and A ∩ B.
stages.customInstructions: Both the union and the intersection are required.

stages.headline: Write all subsets of {a; b}.
stages.customInstructions: All four subsets, including ∅ and the set itself, are required.
